# Chez Marielle

> Event planning and styling in New York City, by Marielle Folan. For brands, in-house event teams, clubs and communities, and anyone hosting at home.

Chez Marielle (Events & Experiences) plans and styles dinner parties, birthdays, brand events, member events, and other gatherings in New York City.

## What I do
- Event planning and production: planned and produced from start to finish, including the idea, the venue, the vendors, the guest list, and the day itself.
- Support for in-house experiential teams: extra support for in-house experiential marketing teams, on a contract or one-off basis.
- Consulting for clubs and community spaces: consulting for members' clubs and community-based spaces on the experiences they create for their members and guests.

## What I can help with
Florals; tablescapes; grazing spreads; printed menus, booklets, and signage; activity stations, like a bouquet bar or DIY wine charms; wine selection and tastings; venue and vendors; day-of setup.

## About
Marielle Folan founded Ladies Wine Club NYC, a community for young professional women in New York with more than 200 members, and has planned and produced more than 20 of its events. She was also Head of Membership at Maxwell Social, a private members' club in New York City, where she planned and produced member events.
